research_question: Using the independently reproduced 2.878972 gradient as the integrity control, does max_norm 0.3 materially change the exact first AdamW parameter update compared with no clipping?

problem.prior_v1_status: invalid because it was incorrectly required to reproduce the superseded 403.728180 artifact
problem.v2_change: Only the gradient-integrity control is corrected; optimizer contract, data, seed, formula, effect thresholds, and zero-update boundaries remain unchanged.

falsifiable_hypothesis.statement: At the exact first AdamW step, clipping the valid 2.878972 raw gradient to 0.3 has a material effect on the hypothetical parameter update.
falsifiable_hypothesis.threshold_note: The thresholds are unchanged from v1 and were not selected after seeing a valid v2 result.

optimizer_contract.name: torch.optim.AdamW
optimizer_contract.first_step_formula: delta = -lr * weight_decay * theta - lr * g / (abs(g) + epsilon)
optimizer_contract.clipped_condition: g is multiplied by min(1, max_norm / (total_norm + 1e-6))
optimizer_contract.unclipped_condition: g is the unchanged accumulated raw gradient

decision_policy.near_equivalent: do not change max_norm; inspect learning-rate step scale
decision_policy.material_effect: authorize one matched clipped-versus-unclipped small training pilot
decision_policy.inconclusive: do not change hyperparameters; design a stronger diagnostic
